summary: Retest of iteration_74 GooglePostResult No-path bug after refactor to isolated useState hooks + remount key. NO path and YES path both PASS with natural user click. The iter_74 refactor is effective — the confirm dialog fully unmounts on 'No', draft-kept note appears, and remaining draft/manual-post UI is preserved. Backend was skipped per request.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside MiraDayOffer.jsx (line ~280). Not introduced this iteration — flagged again.

critical_code_review_comments: GooglePostResult refactor to individual useState hooks (posted/needs/pubResult/declined/busy) + parent key={topic+question} works correctly — no stale state, no unmount issue on 'No, keep as draft'.
Fix the MiraDayOffer.jsx hydration warning (invalid HTML). Non-blocking but present in console every render.

Bug found while seeding: /api/mira-studio/google/... crashes with `TypeError: fromisoformat: argument must be str` when a social_posts doc has `created_at` stored as a real datetime object instead of ISO string (routes/mira_studio.py line 144 catches only ValueError). Recommend `except (ValueError, TypeError):` OR normalize `created_at` at read (isinstance check). Not user-triggered today because app writes strings, but defensive fix is trivial.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 1 social_posts doc {caption:'Morning facial offer [QA-SIM]', platforms:['google'], kind:'google_offer', results.google.ok:true, created_at:<iso today>} for miracurl tenant. DELETED after tests (deleted_count=2 — cleared both today's seed + a leftover; remaining=0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT for future automated tests: Playwright's `element.click(force=True)` on the No button did NOT fire React's onClick handler (confirm dialog remained), which is exactly what iteration_74 reported. However Playwright locator `.click()` WITHOUT force=True, and native `HTMLElement.click()` via page.evaluate, both work correctly and the state updates as designed. This is a Playwright synthetic-event quirk on this button, not a real user bug — real users clicking the button work fine. When seeding social_posts docs for confirm-today tests, ALWAYS store `created_at` as an ISO string (not a Python datetime), otherwise routes/mira_studio.py::_social_context crashes with TypeError and the /google/post endpoint returns 500.
